name: Hat ToF
summary: Returns distance to a target using a VL53L0X time-of-flight sensor.

interface.range_note: Up to 2 m is conditional; vendor notes about 1.2 m in normal mode and 2 m in long-range/dark conditions.

host_bindings.notes: Legacy examples use StickC SDA0/SCL26. StickS3 has a different Hat2-Bus; inspect the HAT schematic and mating orientation before assigning pins. Do not use Grove GPIO9/10 for a directly attached HAT or infer GPIO26 from a StickC example. Use 3.3V, not 5V, for these HAT supply pins.

support.meaning: Manufacturer documentation and source review only. No accessory driver or emulator input is implemented by this record.

first_hardware_check: Confirm actual StickS3 HAT pin mapping and 3.3V supply. Detect 0x29, initialize sensor and set a bounded timeout.
Move a flat target between known distances and check readings plus timeout/out-of-range behavior.
troubleshooting: A timeout or out-of-range status is not zero distance.
Do not confuse the U072 HAT with a Grove ToF Unit or VL53L1X revision.
If combining two 0x29 sensors, plan reset/address reassignment or a suitable multiplexer; address collision is not fixed by parallel wiring.

app_fixture_plan.note: App-owned millimetre fixtures can test UI logic, not optics, measurement accuracy or sensor timing.
